embedding.heading: Embedding (Ask Kompast)
embedding.description: A separate provider from the AI settings above — Anthropic doesn't have a public embeddings API, so Ask Kompast needs Azure OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, regardless of which AI provider is selected above.
embedding.reindexHelp: Re-queues every issue, comment and page in this workspace so Ask Kompast picks up anything it missed. Usually only needed after changing the embedding provider or model. Runs in the background; a large workspace can take a while.
embedding.reindexQueued: Queued for re-indexing: {{issues}} issues, {{comments}} comments, {{pages}} pages.

members.inviteHint: They'll get an email with a link to join this workspace.

roles.intro: The role hierarchy currently in effect in Kompast — not a configurable permission matrix, just a summary of the rules already in the code.

superAdmin.name: Super Admin
superAdmin.desc: Sees every team's projects and docs, plus projects not yet assigned to a team. Creates teams, appoints team admins, and moves projects between teams (member.isSuperAdmin). Transferring this role revokes it from the previous holder.

workspaceOwner.name: Workspace Owner / Admin
workspaceOwner.desc: Can open Settings (Entra/AI/Email integrations) and invite/manage workspace members (member.role). Does not see other teams' content — only the teams they belong to, plus Workspace docs.

teamAdmin.name: Team Admin
teamAdmin.desc: Creates projects in their team, adds workspace members to it, and invites new people straight into it by email (team_member.role). Sees only their own teams' projects and docs.

teamMember.name: Team Member
teamMember.desc: Sees and works in their team's projects and docs, plus shared Workspace docs. Other teams appear only as locked names.

projectRole.name: Project Lead / Contributor / Viewer
projectRole.desc: Project leads (project_member.role = lead) can manage that project's settings — columns and custom fields.

general.heading: Workspace
general.description: How this workspace is named across Kompast — the sidebar, invitations, and emails.
general.nameHint: Only the display name changes; existing links keep working.

departedPages.description: Private and shared pages whose owner has left the workspace. Nobody else can open a private page, so this is the only way to recover them. Every recovery is recorded in the audit log.
departedPages.empty: No departed member has left private pages behind.
